Lines.Text: Boom, boom.
In the pitch-black dark, a deep bass beat thundered like a heart: boom, boom.
Thousands of candles flared to life at once, illuminating the vast arena.
Onstage, the five members of V.E.L.O. stood in black uniforms, radiating an overwhelming presence.
The word idol once meant an object of worship.
And we were the sacrifices who bled for that false idol.
The human world threw these girls away like trash, but...
The performance surged toward its climax.
As Ria, the main vocalist, unleashed a soaring high note, the spirit audience erupted in a frenzy of inhuman cheers.
SKREEEEEE—!!
The sound rattled the bones: bloodcurdling, yet feverishly ecstatic.
And it was more than sound.
The spirits' explosive fervor rose from the stands as a dense blue haze, breaking into luminous particles.
The entire domed arena shimmered with energy both grotesque and beautiful.
(holding a champagne glass in the VIP balcony) Magnificent, Mr. P.
Perfect rapture—the kind humanity's paltry capital could never manufacture.
The blue particles circling overhead spiraled into Moomyeong's glass as if drawn by a spell.
He smiled faintly, savoring the jewel-like light gathered within it.
Breathe it in. Such rich, weighty Resonance.
When it comes to owning a stage, my girls are unmatched in this world or the next.
(leaning on the rail, looking down at the stage with a crooked grin) Damn right.
We were driven from a stage ruled by the human world's petty capital. So we climbed from the darkest floor of the underworld—and swore we would rise high enough to devour the world of the living.
A gorgeous, grotesque ghost story that would enthrall the living and the dead alike. That was us.
The members struck their dazzling final pose.
SCREEEEE—!!
A shriek of microphone feedback tore at their eardrums.
Grotesque static crackled through the hall—and, as if someone had flipped a switch, the world plunged into total darkness.
